audio_url.description: Audio to synchronize the mouth movements to, at least 5 seconds long. Supports up to 15 minutes. The output video matches the supplied audio duration.
audio_url.title: Audio Url

resolution.description: Output resolution. Uses the supported aspect ratio nearest the image.
resolution.title: Resolution

image_url.description: Image to animate. The aspect ratio must be between 0.4 and 2.5.
image_url.title: Image Url

enable_transcription.description: Transcribe the supplied audio to guide lip synchronization. When disabled, synchronize to the audio without a transcript.
enable_transcription.title: Enable Transcription

seed.description: Random seed; selected randomly if omitted.
seed.title: Seed

video.description: Lip-synced video with the supplied soundtrack.

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

video.title: File

timings.description: Timing breakdown in seconds. 'inference' is the DiT denoising time on the GPU backend, summed over every window this request generated. Null on routes that do not report backend timings.
timings.title: Timings
